metadata.author: Aniballers
metadata.description:
Join Essi the lioness and her magical friends in the Aniball Kingdom for a series of fun, football adventures. Perfect for ages 3-8, these stories teach friendship, determination, and football skills through enchanting tales. Each story features the Aniballers team - Essi, Blaze, Trixie, Claw, and Berg - as they practice, play, and discover the magic of football together.Princess Essi dreams of joining the Aniballers. She sneaks away, learns a new football skill, and rescues her first magical Skillzee, proving her determination to play in the Kingdom CupIn the Aniball Kingdom, Essi and her diverse animal teammates practise football, nurture magical Skillzeez, and face rivals, learning teamwork, resilience, and friendship as they strive to win the Kingdom Cup.Aniballers is more than just a podcast, it's a complete learning system, packed with stories, resources, and football skills for families. Created and read by a dad and daughter, we’re building the world’s biggest kids’ football club, Aniballers FC. Our mission is to help children fall in love with being active, while developing emotional resilience, teamwork, and confidence. Through engaging adventures and practical resources, we empower parents to nurture healthy habits and life skills that last a lifetime, making every child feel included and inspired to grow.

Visit Aniballers Web site to join Aniballers FC, the best early years football club in the world!!Join a community of over 200k on Instagram where we celebrate early years football with amazing viral moments and insights tips and skills for you and your family.We also have a weekly newsletter called The Football Parent with tips, drills and inspiration for raising healthy, active kids. Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.
